These snapshots were generated by ASAPPlanner commit
`9acd2982df43ed5f64ccb00b17ce532deb7e7722`, before moving the implementation here.
Both use width 8, depth 3 and candidate capacity 4, with updates
Int64(1): 0.125, Utf8("1"): 0.5 and Null: 0.75.
They verify compatibility with the existing ASAP-WFREQ-1 format, not with
integer sketch formats or other language implementations.
